objects.name: access_tokens
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `access_tokens` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`user_id` integer NOT NULL,`value` text NOT NULL,`expire` datetime NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT `fk_access_tokens_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: albums
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `albums` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`title` text NOT NULL,`parent_album_id` integer,`path` text NOT NULL,`path_hash` text,`cover_id` integer,CONSTRAINT `fk_albums_parent_album` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_album_id`) REFERENCES `albums`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,CONSTRAINT `uni_albums_path_hash` UNIQUE (`path_hash`))

objects.name: face_groups
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `face_groups` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`label` text)

objects.name: image_faces
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `image_faces` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`face_group_id` integer NOT NULL,`media_id` integer NOT NULL,`descriptor` BLOB NOT NULL,`rectangle` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT `fk_media_faces` FOREIGN KEY (`media_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `fk_face_groups_image_faces` FOREIGN KEY (`face_group_id`) REFERENCES `face_groups`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: media
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `media` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`title` text NOT NULL,`path` text NOT NULL,`path_hash` text NOT NULL,`album_id` integer NOT NULL,`exif_id` integer,`date_shot` datetime NOT NULL,`type` text NOT NULL,`video_metadata_id` integer,`side_car_path` text,`side_car_hash` text,`blurhash` text,CONSTRAINT `fk_media_exif` FOREIGN KEY (`exif_id`) REFERENCES `media_exif`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `fk_media_video_metadata` FOREIGN KEY (`video_metadata_id`) REFERENCES `video_metadata`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `fk_media_album` FOREIGN KEY (`album_id`) REFERENCES `albums`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `uni_media_path_hash` UNIQUE (`path_hash`),CONSTRAINT `uni_media_side_car_hash` UNIQUE (`side_car_hash`))

objects.name: media_exif
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `media_exif` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`description` text,`camera` text,`maker` text,`lens` text,`date_shot` datetime,`exposure` real,`aperture` real,`iso` integer,`focal_length` real,`flash` integer,`orientation` integer,`exposure_program` integer,`gps_latitude` real,`gps_longitude` real)

objects.name: media_urls
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `media_urls` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`media_id` integer NOT NULL,`media_name` text NOT NULL,`width` integer NOT NULL,`height` integer NOT NULL,`purpose` text NOT NULL,`content_type` text NOT NULL,`file_size` integer NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT `fk_media_media_url` FOREIGN KEY (`media_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: share_tokens
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `share_tokens` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`value` text NOT NULL,`owner_id` integer NOT NULL,`expire` datetime,`password` text,`album_id` integer,`media_id` integer,CONSTRAINT `fk_share_tokens_media` FOREIGN KEY (`media_id`) REFERENCES `media`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `fk_share_tokens_owner` FOREIGN KEY (`owner_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `fk_share_tokens_album` FOREIGN KEY (`album_id`) REFERENCES `albums`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: site_info
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `site_info` (`initial_setup` numeric NOT NULL,`periodic_scan_interval` integer NOT NULL,`concurrent_workers` integer NOT NULL,`thumbnail_method` text NOT NULL)

objects.name: user_albums
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `user_albums` (`album_id` integer,`user_id` integer,PRIMARY KEY (`album_id`,`user_id`),CONSTRAINT `fk_user_albums_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,CONSTRAINT `fk_user_albums_album` FOREIGN KEY (`album_id`) REFERENCES `albums`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: user_media_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `user_media_data` (`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`user_id` integer,`media_id` integer,`favorite` numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT false,PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`media_id`))

objects.name: user_preferences
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `user_preferences` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`user_id` integer NOT NULL,`language` text,CONSTRAINT `fk_user_preferences_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

objects.name: users
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `users` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`username` text,`password` text,`admin` numeric DEFAULT false,CONSTRAINT `uni_users_username` UNIQUE (`username`))

objects.name: video_metadata
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE `video_metadata` (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,`created_at` datetime,`updated_at` datetime,`width` integer NOT NULL,`height` integer NOT NULL,`duration` real NOT NULL,`codec` text,`framerate` real,`bitrate` text,`color_profile` text,`audio` text)
